measurement.load_policy: ordinary load; no waiting for quiet; no load-based reruns or exclusions
measurement.fixture: Baseline semantics: temporary HOME/config/store; post_tool_use providers=[capture], session_start providers=[toz_note], instruction target in temporary repo; output bytes in tool_response.stdout and command="cat README.md", command-shape bytes in tool_input.command. Store reused for all 30 internal samples.
measurement.timer: Outer profile wall samples include a Python -c driver which starts installed varde-toz; driver startup, child interpreter startup, and installed CLI imports are measured as separate startup references.

baseline_comparison.fixture_and_installed_entrypoint: same launcher and fixture semantics as baseline.json
baseline_comparison.remaining_difference: Profile uses a generated python -c subprocess driver and a fresh temporary fixture path; baseline used a generated run.py driver. Both start the same installed launcher and use equivalent provider/config/payload semantics. The residual 3.2 ms (200 B) and 6.2 ms (64 KiB) differences are observed run-to-run/timer-driver variance, not a different entry point or payload shape.

failed_attempts.reason: Incorrectly nested perf_run --runs 30 around profile_phases.py --runs 30; corrected to one profiler invocation under perf_run, with 30 inner samples retained.

method: Begin/end spans report exclusive durations; nested durations are subtracted from parent spans. Every phase name is aliased. Each row retains 30 wall samples and 30 raw samples for every phase; load and lock metadata describe the single perf_run invocation around each row.
